def _pdf_pageinfo_sync_init(infile: Path, pdfminer_loglevel):
    global worker_pdf  # pylint: disable=global-statement
    pikepdf_enable_mmap()

    logging.getLogger('pdfminer').setLevel(pdfminer_loglevel)

    worker_pdf = pikepdf.open(infile)
